lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white line segments visible across the torso. Spacing is variable, with higher frequency in the mid-torso and wider intervals at the anterior and posterior boundaries.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the anterior at the dorsal terminus; a Y-shaped split is visible on the 7th line segment at the mid-lateral vertical axis.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1, 2, and 11 terminate mid-torso. Lines 5 and 8 exhibit pixel-level luminance gaps, creating a dashed appearance rather than continuous vertical strokes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Approximately 7 high-contrast spots arranged in a low-density cluster on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the lateral aspect of the upper hind limb align horizontally, creating a short geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the malar region of the face; white horizontal banding present on the proximal section of the forelimbs.
